name: local_reproducible_output
title: Make output reproducible for one scope

origin.description: Set width, color, collation, and console options for one scope, then restore them.
origin.usage: local_reproducible_output(width = 80, crayon = FALSE, unicode = FALSE, hyperlinks = FALSE, rstudio = FALSE, .local_envir = parent.frame())

arguments.name: crayon
arguments.text: When false, color is turned off.

arguments.name: unicode
arguments.text: When false, unicode output is turned off.

arguments.name: hyperlinks
arguments.text: When false, hyperlinks are turned off.

arguments.name: rstudio
arguments.text: When false, RStudio ansi and hyperlink options are turned off.

origin.details: In Python this is a context manager. Options, environment variables, and the collation locale are restored on the way out.
origin.value: None. The changed settings last for the scope.

translation.example:

    print("inside", option("width"), os.environ["NO_COLOR"])
print("after", option("width"))
